tests.title: Actual host
tests.expected: non-root uid; verified worktree/origin; supplied Rust target/toolchain; rootless Docker checked separately, no secrets in report.

tests.title: Recovery utility
tests.expected: start/checkpoint/finish/block/resume; bounded indices; orphan detection; dirty Git reconciliation; no reset on resume.

tests.title: Workspace
tests.expected: edition 2024/resolver3; dependency directions; mock slice compiles; Cargo.lock and exact toolchain checked in.

tests.title: Quality
tests.expected: cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace --locked; no ignored required tests.

tests.title: Standalone
tests.expected: cargo build --locked and cargo build; target/debug/oc --help; core app runs with PATH without node/bun/upstream, external MCP disabled.

tests.title: User forms
tests.expected: JSONC fragments assembled into valid config; native TOML separate; ludka static/ludka2 discovery; timeout:false and chunkTimeout preserved.

tests.title: Substitution/merge
tests.expected: baseline source-derived env/file escaping, precedence and permission merge; source/field diagnostics; original configs byte-unchanged.

tests.title: Capability failures
tests.expected: unknown npm, explicit codemode:true, OAuth:true or unsupported DCP mode give actionable errors; not silent acceptance.

tests.title: Secrets/disabled
tests.expected: missing env on unselected provider does not block selected one; disabled MCP launches nothing; config explain/logs redacted.

tests.title: Config roots
tests.expected: source-derived global/Location JSON/JSONC and .opencode order, canonical dedup and field provenance are deterministic; explicit config and separate cli.json behavior remain intact; inputs byte-unchanged.

tests.title: Instructions
tests.expected: global and applicable Location AGENTS sentinels enter provider instructions once in pinned order with provenance; unreadable/disappeared files are diagnosed and candidate generation retains no stale text.

tests.title: Definitions
tests.expected: singular/plural skill/agent/command roots, supported frontmatter and domain collisions are deterministic; invalid definition reports path/field/reason while valid siblings survive; selected/default invalid and subagent/reserved behavior fail explicitly.

tests.title: Native plugins
tests.expected: only exact bare/pinned DCP identities and admitted openproxy-models.js markers classify idempotently; unknown/lookalike/version/JS/TS sources fail before resolver/import/process/network and no plugin code executes.

tests.title: Vertical session
tests.expected: input→mock stream→persist→resume, identical application behavior local/headless.

tests.title: Lock/atomicity
tests.expected: second data root owner refused; state and event transactional; durable ack only after commit.

tests.title: Crash operations
tests.expected: kill after intent before/after side effect; recover unknown/partial, never autoreplay mutation.

tests.title: Blob failures
tests.expected: disk-full/read-only/blob-before-DB orphan behavior; no referenced blob deletion; quotas enforced.

tests.title: Cancel/shutdown
tests.expected: worker responsive during streaming; DB drained, terminal restored, own children reaped; no tasks retained per past session.

tests.title: Read/search
tests.expected: bounded file chunks, glob/grep stable sorted results, pagination, binary/large file diagnostics, no own data dir recursion.

tests.title: Patch create
tests.expected: new/empty file, append to existing empty file, Unicode/CRLF/end newline; exact patch grammar fixtures.

tests.title: Patch edit/delete/move
tests.expected: targeted hunks/full text replacement/delete/move supported; no write/edit in model registry.

tests.title: Patch conflicts
tests.expected: Add existing, stale preimage, invalid later entry, protected/outside/symlink path; no success on partial; per-file result.

tests.title: Shell output
tests.expected: interleaved stdout/stderr >caps; no deadlock/unbounded accumulation; correct exit status/truncation.

tests.title: Shell cancel
tests.expected: timeout/TERM-resistant child/grandchild; KILL/wait/reap; elapsed bound; unknown versus cancelled outcomes.

tests.title: Web text
tests.expected: GET text/HTML/JSON, status/content type/original URL, bounded readable output and redirects.

tests.title: Web safety
tests.expected: private/link-local/loopback, DNS rebinding, IPv6 mapped address, redirect-to-private, large body, deadline; auth not inherited.

tests.title: Permissions
tests.expected: same path for all tools incl MCP/compress; ask headless fails; invalid config never allows; patch legacy deny wins.

tests.title: Tool graph
tests.expected: unknown tool/invalid JSON/duplicate call IDs/replayed done event do not execute; results match original call IDs.

tests.title: Skill loading
tests.expected: model sees bounded id/name/description without bodies; skill uses central permission and pinned bounded generation snapshot; unknown/removed/oversized/unreadable/stale calls fail visibly with a valid durable tool graph.

tests.title: Basic dynamic
tests.expected: unknown/new model IDs including slash, source suffix once, name formatting; no code changes/model list fallback.

tests.title: Metadata
tests.expected: JS safe integer/null-object/booleans/modalities validation; one invalid row leaves whole old catalog unchanged.

tests.title: Authority
tests.expected: ignore remote URL/npm/auth/options fields; credentials remain original; redirect:error.

tests.title: Merge
tests.expected: original local snapshot only; shallow nested limit/variants; explicit local override wins; local-only IDs removed on success.

tests.title: Limits
tests.expected: discovery context/input capped 500000; output unchanged; missing context/output removes limit; static ludka 628000 unaffected.

tests.title: Variants
tests.expected: remote allowlist disables missing standard names; custom names/effort retained; disabled hidden; local explicit override works.

tests.title: Timing
tests.expected: fake clock: each attempt ≤15000ms, total ≤30000ms incl body, ≤4 attempts and clipped 250/750/1500 delays; cancellation cleanup.

tests.title: Retry classes
tests.expected: 408/425/429/5xx/network/invalid JSON/empty retry; auth/bad shape/invalid row terminal; no retry layer multiplication.

tests.title: Publication
tests.expected: empty cold list never clears configured models; success removes retired IDs; duplicate ID last wins; bounded size failures atomic.

tests.title: Isolation
tests.expected: disabled provider no fetch; two provider/config generations independent; failed refresh never turns remote data into local overrides.

tests.title: Request
tests.expected: exact base prefix+/responses, Bearer, store:false, input/tool schemas and stable prompt_cache_key; no OAuth or API fallback.

tests.title: SSE
tests.expected: arbitrary byte split, multiline/CRLF/comments/UTF8, text/item/argument stream incremental; event cap enforced.

tests.title: Tool roundtrip
tests.expected: complete arguments→native tool→function_call_output→next response; multi-call order and ID validity.

tests.title: Reasoning
tests.expected: opaque/reasoning items persisted/replayed at correct boundary; model/provider switch does not reuse alien state; no opaque UI logging.

tests.title: Images
tests.expected: advertised text/image accepts bounded verified attachment; encoded request cap, unsupported audio/video/pdf visible.

tests.title: Errors
tests.expected: 401/403/429/5xx, incomplete/EOF, failure after delta; one retry owner, never repeat committed generation/tool.

tests.title: Timeouts
tests.expected: timeout:false no total deadline; chunkTimeout 6000000 not 6000; explicit cancel still closes request; connect separately bounded.

tests.title: Live wire
tests.expected: real proxy published model text+tool roundtrip; record actual model/variant/deployment evidence; not infer all-model parity.

tests.title: Projection
tests.expected: raw history checksum stable; durable compression/prune state changes only outbound context; no second history copy.

tests.title: Range schema
tests.expected: topic/content/startId/endId/summary; upstream reference parsing, invalid/stale/cross-session IDs and unfinished groups rejected.

tests.title: Nested/protected
tests.expected: upstream-derived overlapping/nested summaries, cycle/size checks; protected tool/file/tag/user bytes preserved.

tests.title: Patch protection
tests.expected: all affected paths parsed from patch; apply_patch treated as protected mutation equivalent; large protected content visible failure not loss.

tests.title: Nudges
tests.expected: threshold/percent/per-model, summary buffer, frequency/iteration/turn reset; no accumulating prompt-message copies.

tests.title: Prune timing
tests.expected: dedup and error input purge recalc at compression; latest required output and error text retained; protected/manual policy tested.

tests.title: Config/control
tests.expected: DCP precedence/read-only files, range permission and manual mode, notifications/stats; unsupported experimental options explicit.

tests.title: Recovery
tests.expected: cancel/stale generation/transaction failure cannot half-apply projection; restart reproduces same effective context and continuation.

tests.title: Effectiveness
tests.expected: synthetic large closed span yields smaller outbound serialized context, required facts retained; no-gain compression bounded, not loop.

tests.title: Remote JSON
tests.expected: 2025-11-25 initialize/headers, bearer, POST/JSON, no session ID/GET dependency; observed OpenProxy shape supported.

tests.title: Remote lifecycle
tests.expected: JSON/SSE adapter paths, 405 optional GET, auth/timeout/invalid replies, cancellation and list update; no reconnect storm.

tests.title: Registry
tests.expected: namespaced collision-safe names map exact server/tool, paginated bounded schema/catalog, isError surfaced.

tests.title: Stdio
tests.expected: fake child JSON-RPC stdout + bounded stderr, kill/reap, restart config generation, no cross-auth/cwd sharing.

tests.title: Disabled browser
tests.expected: exact npx argv preserved; enabled:false zero process/browser probe and no Node requirement; true explicitly selected fake/real smoke.

tests.title: Live search
tests.expected: real codex_web search returns non-fabricated content/result; actual errors propagate; no auto OAuth or unknown-effect retry.

tests.title: Basic PTY
tests.expected: input/paste/Unicode/resize, streamed response and Ctrl-C, terminal restoration on error/panic/exit.

tests.title: Model picker
tests.expected: dynamic catalog/variants/refresh status, user choice persisted, retired model actionable, no automatic silent fallback.

tests.title: History/diff
tests.expected: pagination/session switch/resume/tool cards/diff without whole-history rendering/backing-store growth.

tests.title: DCP panel
tests.expected: context/stats/manual controls, /dcp-compress focus becomes bounded instruction, notification not duplicate history.

tests.title: Headless JSON
tests.expected: NDJSON only stdout; errors stderr; bounded slow consumer; interrupted exit code non-success.

tests.title: Workspace definitions
tests.expected: primary-agent selection, slash completion/invocation, skill catalog/tool card, redacted provenance/diagnostic and Location switch use one current-generation registry; stale actions fail and old local entries disappear.

tests.title: Offline coding
tests.expected: scripted provider fixes seeded Rust bug through read/apply_patch/bash; fixture tests pass; no edits outside fixture.

tests.title: Live coding
tests.expected: published model solves same small fixture with actual tool use; API/facts/tests verified, bounded requests; semantic output not exact text match.

tests.title: Compress then resume
tests.expected: model calls compress then uses retained fact to patch/test; restart and next prompt succeed; output context reduced.

tests.title: Web workflow
tests.expected: webfetch tool and codex_web search preserve source info; browser smoke conditional on explicit opt-in, never claimed if not run.

tests.title: Configured workspace
tests.expected: offline scripted provider consumes global plus Location A instructions/agent/command/skill with skill body absent until call and both native aliases wired; switch to B retains global, removes A-local and uses no JS/Node/Bun/network.

tests.title: Soak
tests.expected: 10000 scripted turns over bounded active context, ≥100 sessions/switches, periodic compress/cancel/MCP error, stable resource counters.

tests.title: Output pressure
tests.expected: large shell/provider/tool outputs, slow UI, queue cap, blob quota, cancellation under load; no hidden second transcript.

tests.title: Measurements
tests.expected: baseline/peak/post-idle RSS/PSS plus task/process/queue/cache/DB/WAL metrics; allocator RSS alone not leak conclusion.

tests.title: Regression
tests.expected: fixed workload/seeds/toolchain/machine; adopt baseline-derived caps, compare no linear retained-history slope; clean shutdown checked.

tests.title: Provenance
tests.expected: DCP/OpenCode borrowed code/prompts/tests have pinned source/license/notices; no unsupported license claims for OpenProxy copied code.

tests.title: Secrets Git
tests.expected: review staged tracked content/fixtures/reports; no keys/URL credentials/raw payload/DB/.local; push normal own branch only.

tests.title: Goal handoff
tests.expected: A01–A13 independent status, command exits/commit/live blockers; READY only required live passes; delivery status separate.

tests.title: Fresh restart
tests.expected: new test HOME/XDG/data, built oc starts without upstream/Node, examples read-only, new sessions persist; no migration/release code.
